spellbook.finance/limitations: Preparation saves a frozen batch; it does not approve or submit prices.
Only an interactive workspace owner can approve or revoke in the web app. Unsupported or incomplete listing identity refuses preparation.

description: Prepare an immutable eBay pricing batch from selected inventory items. Returns exact listing identities, executable USD cents, complete physical membership and approval state. Ask the owner to review the batch in the web app, then call spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_get before execution.

itemIds.description: Physical inventory item IDs to resolve into complete active eBay listings. The server refuses selections beyond its bounded listing or membership limit.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_prepare
